summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Capstok landing page. Most features working correctly including navigation, products display, contact info, and mobile responsiveness. Found 2 issues: hero title typo and non-functional admin mode.

ui_bugs.issue: Hero title has typo: 'Welcome to asafer future' instead of 'Welcome to a safer future' (missing space)

integration_issues.issue: Admin mode not activating when typing '1990' - keydown events are captured but admin banner doesn't appear

passed_tests: Hero section displays with logo, navigation, background image, and buttons
Navigation links work with smooth scrolling to all sections (Waarom Capstok, Producten, Over Ons, Contact)
Products section shows CAPSTOK Wit and CAPSTOK Zwart both priced at €16,99
Contact section displays correct email (info@capstok.nl) and phone (+31 6 81140979)
Mobile menu functionality works perfectly - opens/closes correctly, all navigation links functional
Footer displays correctly with logo, navigation links, and copyright text
Responsive design works across desktop and mobile viewports
All interactive elements are clickable and functional
Smooth scrolling works for all navigation links
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix hero title typo (missing space in 'Welcome to a safer future') and debug admin mode activation - keydown events are being captured but the sequence detection logic isn't triggering the admin mode state change
